ios-engineering:ios-01.title: Sign-out / expiry / account deletion never clears the UserDefaults snapshot cache — next launch boots the previous account's data and mislabels an explicit sign-out as "session expired"

ios-engineering:ios-02.title: Session hard-expires after 30 days with no refresh — iOS never touches Auth.js's session endpoint, so a daily user is forced to re-login monthly with the wrong "session expired" framing

ios-engineering:ios-03.title: 3-minute staleness gate disables Approve/Run/Watchlist/Policy after any quiet 3 minutes because there is no polling fallback and SSE only fires on demand-driven events

ios-engineering:ios-04.title: Cached snapshot is stamped `lastUpdatedAt = Date()` at init, so a days-old cache shows a green "Updated · now" pill and passes the staleness gate for 3 minutes

ios-engineering:ios-05.title: Cold-start push tap can be dropped: `route` is nil until ContentView's `.task` runs `configure(route:)`, and `didReceive` calls `self.route?(destination)` with no buffering

ios-engineering:ios-06.title: Push registration has no automatic retry — a 5xx during a deploy swap at cold start leaves alerts `.failed` until the next cold launch, and `.awaitingToken` offers no action

ios-engineering:ios-07.title: Login failures surface as "Apple Sign-In failed: Your session expired.  Sign in again." — 401/403 bodies from the auth routes are dropped by the unauthorized mapping

ios-engineering:ios-08.title: Required numeric/string fields inside array elements fail the whole snapshot decode on a single null — one bad position/fill/alert row blanks the app

ios-engineering:ios-09.title: No CI job runs the Swift test suite — ios-build.yml compiles only, the ship script archives only; 15 XCTest files (~2.4k lines) never execute anywhere but a developer's Mac

ios-engineering:ios-10.title: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy still absent although the app uses UserDefaults (required-reason API) — ITMS-91053 on upload / future App Store rejection

ios-engineering:ios-11.title: MobileStore and PushNotificationCoordinator are `ObservableObject` (repo rule: @Observable, never ObservableObject) and re-publish `isStreamConnected = true` on every SSE line, invalidating every subscribed view

ios-engineering:ios-12.title: No retry on 5xx for idempotent GETs (snapshot has no retry at all) and Cloudflare mapping stops at 523 — deploy-swap 502/503s and 524s reach the user raw

ios-engineering:ios-13.title: SSE reconnect is a fixed 5 s loop with no backoff, and every scene `.active` tears down a healthy stream and fires a second `load()` concurrent with bootstrap's

ios-engineering:ios-14.title: Session cookie and full portfolio snapshot live in backed-up, non-Keychain stores; the snapshot blob is rewritten to UserDefaults on every reload

ios-engineering:ios-15.title: 401 handling is inconsistent across passthroughs — Coach/Scan/Symbol/DataSources/Guardrails show text but never clear the session, so the app can stay "signed in" with a dead cookie

ios-engineering:ios-16.title: Fill and price-alert push links carry `?symbol=` but the router drops it — taps land on the Assets tab instead of the ticker sheet

ios-engineering:ios-17.title: Delivered notifications are never removed once a proposal is handled, and `.badge` is requested but never managed

ios-engineering:ios-18.title: No optional biometric app lock for a device that holds a 30-day trading session

ios-engineering:ios-19.title: Production origin is hardcoded in LoginView (web-auth start + callback), AdminPortalView and DeepLink with no debug override — every simulator run hits production

ios-engineering:ios-20.title: Project builds in Swift 5.9 language mode with no strict-concurrency checking; actor-crossing closures and mutable captures are unchecked

ios-engineering:ios-21.title: `Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues:)` in CommandAttemptTracker.reconcile traps on duplicate command ids

trading-money-path:tsx-01.title: Alpaca MCP placement falls back to REST after any MCP error and re-submits the same client_order_id; the duplicate 422 is then filed as rejected_by_broker while the first order lives at the broker

trading-money-path:tsx-02.title: Auto stale-exit remediation cancel-replaces ANY working sell/cover limit or stop_limit older than 15 min with a MARKET order — including activated bracket take-profit legs, bracket stop_limit legs and owner-placed GTC sells

trading-money-path:tsx-03.title: iOS shows 'Approved — waiting for desk refresh' (green check) for approvals that returned busy/blocked/rejected_by_broker/not_placed/error

trading-money-path:tsx-04.title: Any HTTP 4xx from the broker — including 429 rate-limit and 408 — is filed as a definitive terminal rejected_by_broker without a refId check

trading-money-path:tsx-05.title: Alpaca getEquityOrders walks the ENTIRE order history (up to 50×500 pages) on every call, and 3+ scheduler lanes call it every 60s per account

trading-money-path:tsx-06.title: Alpaca getEquityTradability is a stub (tradable:true, fractional:true for every symbol) — shortable/fractionable/easy_to_borrow are never checked pre-flight

trading-money-path:tsx-07.title: Alpaca extended-hours LIMIT entries keep time_in_force=gtc; Alpaca requires DAY for extended_hours=true, so a whole-share ext-hours entry the owner approved 422s

trading-money-path:tsx-08.title: Manually cancelling an app-managed protective stop from the console/iOS is silently undone next tick — the reconciler deletes the row and places a fresh stop; the cancel sheet promises 'No new order is placed'

trading-money-path:tsx-09.title: Approval-time ratio re-anchoring moves EXIT limits with the market — a held take-profit sell at $110 (ref $100) is placed at $99 if the quote fell to $90; entries chase upward inside the drift cap

trading-money-path:tsx-10.title: Approve is starved for the entire duration of an autonomous run (which can be 15-20 min per STATUS.md) because executeProposal contends for the whole-run strategy lock; console gives up after ~2 min, iOS shows 'Approved' (tsx-03)

trading-money-path:tsx-11.title: Hard-coded 5% opening-order headroom gate shrinks the owner's own per-order cap with no policy toggle — a human-approved $490 order against a $500 maxOrderNotional is blocked at approval

trading-money-path:tsx-12.title: 'Not placed — safe to retry' has no retry path: not_placed is terminal and executeProposal refuses anything but status=proposed

trading-money-path:tsx-13.title: Robinhood adapter silently converts a fractional/dollar BUY LIMIT (or ext-hours entry) into a regular-hours MARKET order with no audit; the persisted proposal and fill receipt still say 'limit'

trading-money-path:tsx-14.title: Stale-exit remediation on live spams 'stale_exit_auto_remediation_deferred' every 60s per resting sell limit and pushes a misleading 'limit order still working — cancel/reprice before replacing with market' alert for bracket take-profit legs

trading-money-path:tsx-15.title: Console decision-sheet Approve toasts positive 'Approved · Order status: busy/blocked/error' for non-placed outcomes

trading-money-path:tsx-16.title: Policy hard-gate copy is broker-specific: 'No Robinhood account is selected.' fires for Alpaca/Tradier accounts

trading-money-path:tsx-17.title: Daily notional/order-count budget resets at America/New_York midnight while every owner-facing timestamp is Central — the 'Today' budget chip rolls over at 11pm CT

trading-money-path:tsx-18.title: Tradier single-leg path sends the raw (unrounded) limit price and always attaches `stop` even on limit/market types, unlike its own bracket path

trading-money-path:tsx-19.title: Alpaca MCP placement path never forwards extended_hours, so an approved ext-hours limit entry over alpaca-mcp is silently placed as a regular-hours order

backend-reliability:berel-01.title: FTS5 idempotency DELETE/COUNT use equality on non-rowid columns = full-table scan per chunk; this, not tokenization, is the ~165-300ms/row that pins the loop

backend-reliability:berel-02.title: listFillEvents returns the OLDEST 500 fills (ORDER BY filled_at ASC LIMIT 500) so P&L, open lots, tax, model-stats and dashboard silently freeze once an account passes 500 fills

backend-reliability:berel-03.title: Broker calls have no HTTP timeout (Alpaca SDK axios default 0; Tradier fetch has no signal) and the scheduler's stop-monitor / stale-exit lanes are guarded by in-flight sets that only release when the hung promise settles

backend-reliability:berel-04.title: filing-body-ingest, persistLocalComplete and document-summarizer still mirror whole documents into FTS synchronously with no yield and no in-flight-strategy gate — the same pin class the SEC worker was bounded against

backend-reliability:berel-05.title: Docker HEALTHCHECK (5 s timeout) probes the heavy /api/health — measured 4.2 s under loop load — so a modest pin flips the container unhealthy and a Coolify restart re-halts autonomy

backend-reliability:berel-06.title: No event-loop lag instrumentation anywhere — every loop-pin incident was reconstructed from broker latency and Uptime Robot; retries under a pin (awaitWithFirstCallRetry) just double broker load

backend-reliability:berel-07.title: All CPU-heavy RAG work (HTML extraction, chunking, FTS5 writes, JSON.parse of MB artifacts) runs on the single serving+trading event loop; no worker_threads or sidecar exists

backend-reliability:berel-08.title: Scheduler tick has no re-entrancy guard: setInterval fires every 60 s while a tick can await serial per-account broker health calls and then all strategy runs, so ticks overlap and unguarded per-tick lanes stack under exactly the slow-broker conditions of 08-18

backend-reliability:berel-09.title: Alpaca getEquityOrders walks the ENTIRE order history (status:all, up to 50×500) on every call, and it is called every 60 s by the stale-limit lane and again by pending-fill reconcile and the dashboard

backend-reliability:berel-10.title: Each embed_queued resume slice re-reads the raw filing, JSON.parses sections and chunks artifacts and runs two full-scan FTS COUNTs before writing 6 chunks — fixed sync overhead repeated ~150 times per large filing

backend-reliability:berel-11.title: busy_timeout = 60000 on a synchronous single-connection means any external writer contention (rolling-deploy sibling container, litestream checkpoint) freezes the whole process — HTTP, health probe and scheduler — for up to a minute

backend-reliability:berel-12.title: hasInFlightStrategyWork / markStaleRunningRuns scan strategy_runs by status with no status-leading index; the check runs every 5 s in the SEC worker, per FTS slice and per ROIC period

backend-reliability:berel-13.title: litestream-runtime.log is appended forever with tee -a on the persistent volume; nothing rotates or truncates it

backend-reliability:berel-14.title: Several always-growing tables have no retention: llm_usage, notification_events, portfolio_snapshots (positions JSON per run), sec_ingest_task_attempts (one row per FTS slice), strategy_runs, history_cache_eod, processed_webhooks

backend-reliability:berel-15.title: Alpaca trade-updates stream captures credentials once at start and has no idle/ping watchdog, so a rotated key or a half-open socket silently stops streamed fills until redeploy

backend-reliability:berel-16.title: /api/health flags that matter for a trader (schedulerStale, tradingLivenessDegraded, storage/litestream degraded) are informational JSON only; the public probe stays 200 and only openrouterCredits is keyword-monitored

security-auth:sec-01.title: Production boots with no AUTH_SECRET guard: a missing secret turns every anonymous request into the owner

security-auth:sec-02.title: Origin is directly reachable at <PROD_ORIGIN_IP>:443 with Host: socratictrade.com — every Cloudflare layer (WAF, bot/UA rules, upload cap, cf-connecting-ip trust) is bypassable

security-auth:sec-03.title: next-auth 5.0.0-beta.31 / @auth/core 0.41.2 carries three published advisories (one critical) with a fix one beta ahead

security-auth:sec-04.title: Sessions cannot be revoked: 30-day stateless JWT, sign-out is cookie-delete only, no 'sign out everywhere', no absolute lifetime

security-auth:sec-05.title: Mobile web-auth handoff mints a session code for ANY authenticated GET with an arbitrary code_challenge — a scheme-squatting app plus one tapped link steals a 30-day session

security-auth:sec-06.title: Unauthenticated /api/mobile/auth/exchange buffers an unbounded JSON body (and /api/mobile/auth/apple has no rate limit) on the single process that also runs trading

security-auth:sec-07.title: Middleware matcher skips any path ending in .png/.svg/... including /api/* — identity-header stripping, CSRF, and auth do not run there

security-auth:sec-08.title: 228 lib/db functions default userId to "local" (the owner's account) — a forgotten argument silently reads or writes the owner's data

security-auth:sec-09.title: Native Sign in with Apple does not use a nonce, so a captured identity token is replayable for its lifetime

security-auth:sec-10.title: CSP has been report-only since 2026-07-01 with unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval; nothing is enforced and reports only go to console.log

security-auth:sec-11.title: /api/ops/* falls back to ADMIN_REINDEX_TOKEN when OPS_DIAGNOSTIC_TOKEN is unset — one token spans two trust levels

security-auth:sec-12.title: x-admin-token path has no rate limit and no failure audit; middleware lets any bearer/x-admin-token request straight to admin handlers

security-auth:sec-13.title: POST /api/mobile/push/register reassigns a device token owned by another user to the caller

security-auth:sec-14.title: No local app lock on iOS: the 30-day session cookie is available to anyone holding the unlocked phone

llm-agent-architecture:llm-01.title: Bull strict JSON schema lists `exitPlan` in properties but not in `required` — OpenAI-family Green seats 400 since 2026-08-16 (misdiagnosed as 'terra unservable')

llm-agent-architecture:llm-02.title: Red Team reviewer resolves the ACTIVE console account, not the account under review (venue/short capability, execution mode, strategy prompt)

llm-agent-architecture:llm-03.title: Delta-only macro pruning strips unchanged FRED fields from every run after the first — the stateless model never sees values the prompt tells it to use

llm-agent-architecture:llm-04.title: Daily LLM learning review auto-approves strategy-directive pending rows into the strategy prompt as TRUSTED owner text (contract says human approval required)

llm-agent-architecture:llm-05.title: Approved coach directives are appended to the ACTIVE account's strategy prompt (and user/profile prompt) regardless of the pending row's account

llm-agent-architecture:llm-06.title: 'Retry Red Team' stamps approve-at-half / reject verdicts without applying the haircut or hold — approving the card places FULL size

llm-agent-architecture:llm-07.title: Every Red Team review re-sends the ENTIRE Green user content (all candidates, RAG, learned, reflection, scorecards) — RedTeamReviewContext documents a subset the code ignores

llm-agent-architecture:llm-08.title: Strict-parse path trusts provider schema enforcement; json_object transports (DeepSeek, Gemini fallback) can deliver off-playbook tags / non-venue types / null enums that sanitizeProposals silently normalizes

llm-agent-architecture:llm-09.title: Late (post-soft-timeout) LLM responses are audited but never metered; Red Team late responses are not captured at all — the Usage page and budget ledger miss the most expensive calls

llm-agent-architecture:llm-10.title: Hardcoded 'dead' OpenRouter model list drops claude-fable-5 and kimi-latest from rotation although the live catalog serves both slugs today

llm-agent-architecture:llm-11.title: Under rotation the approval card asserts 'this run's rotation pick, not a failover' even when an implicit fallback (the cheapest seats) actually served the proposal

llm-agent-architecture:llm-12.title: Coach/Assistant routes models to NATIVE providers while the engine, rotation and the policy save-gate assume universal OpenRouter — an OpenRouter-only owner sees 'no key' for every Coach model and llama routes to OpenAI

llm-agent-architecture:llm-13.title: Learned-context semantic gate resolves its LLM via env CHAT_LLM (getLLM) — MockLLM in production, so the 'on by default' second-layer risk classifier is silently inert

llm-agent-architecture:llm-14.title: Strategy page Red Team hint describes the retired two-pass design ('deeper adversarial debate on high-conviction … ideas'); fallback hint hides the implicit rotation fallback

llm-agent-architecture:llm-15.title: /console/usage still shows no embedding/rerank spend — RAG cost is only on the admin RAG-coverage page

llm-agent-architecture:llm-16.title: OpenRouter's billed `usage.cost` is never requested or stored; all cost figures come from a hand-maintained price table

llm-agent-architecture:llm-17.title: No Settings nudge when Green and Red are the same model (the owner-approved replacement for the dropped hard independence rule)

llm-agent-architecture:llm-18.title: Pending-proposal revalidation feeds raw rationale (persisted model + Red text) to a withdraw/reaffirm reviewer with no containment and no data-not-command clause

llm-agent-architecture:llm-19.title: 'Mock - deterministic, no key' is a product-facing model in the Coach picker (a test/simulation mode in the console)

llm-agent-architecture:llm-20.title: Prompt versions bump weekly (2.8→2.12 in 10 days) with no behavioral eval — the 'offline strategy eval' scores fixtures, not model output; no recorded-payload replay per version

market-data-integrity:mdi-01.title: Weekend TTL extension fires during Friday's live session: screener/OHLC/enrichment caches freeze until Monday

market-data-integrity:mdi-02.title: Daily-bar cache served as 'fresh' for 3 calendar days: series lags up to two sessions and today's partial bar is persisted as an EOD close

market-data-integrity:mdi-03.title: Cascade stamps cache-served provider values with a 'now' fetchedAt/asOf; nasdaq-quote price/change/volume are cached 6h and win volume arbitration on fabricated recency

market-data-integrity:mdi-04.title: asOf fabricated from the wall clock (Yahoo quote-only fallback, ROIC profile price, CBOE, grouped VWAP) defeats the quote-staleness gate

market-data-integrity:mdi-05.title: Alpaca broker quote 'price' is the ASK; it becomes the displayed Price, watchlist price, alert trigger and stop/take-profit mark, while Chg% stays the screener's

market-data-integrity:mdi-06.title: Interactive Scan VWAP is yesterday's grouped-daily VWAP stamped with fetch time and described as today's session

market-data-integrity:mdi-07.title: Nasdaq screener asOf is a sentence ('Last price as of Aug 18, 2026'); it is stored as MarketQuote.asOf and renders 'Invalid Date' in the drilldown

market-data-integrity:mdi-08.title: Dynamic universes (NYSE/Nasdaq Composite, FT Wilshire 5000) include preferreds, baby bonds and units — ~20% of the NYSE screener

market-data-integrity:mdi-09.title: 'volume' mixes session, 10-day average and IEX-only volume across providers, feeding liquidity score, dollar-volume floor and outlier detection

market-data-integrity:mdi-10.title: No early-close (1:00 PM ET) calendar: sessions read 'regular' until 4 PM on half-days

market-data-integrity:mdi-11.title: History cascade merges split-only, split+dividend and IEX-only bars into one series/cache without tagging the adjustment basis

market-data-integrity:mdi-12.title: Yahoo v7 batch quote runs without the crumb session the repo says v7 now requires; failure is silent and the fallback fans out unbounded per-symbol chart calls

market-data-integrity:mdi-13.title: Snapshot/benchmark day keys use the UTC date: evening (post-market) snapshots align to the NEXT session's SPY close

market-data-integrity:mdi-14.title: Dead mock enrichment tier still exported (hash-generated PE/EPS/dividends/headlines) despite AGENTS.md saying it was removed

market-data-integrity:mdi-15.title: Index membership is a static Wikipedia snapshot from 2026-06-14; the live S&P 500 constituents module has no consumer

market-data-integrity:mdi-16.title: Delayed/cached provenance not surfaced: iOS scan says 'as of <generatedAt>', web chip says 'fresh', dashboard tile shows no age

market-data-integrity:mdi-17.title: Watchlist shows a bare price: no age, no change, raw provider id, and the price is the broker ask

market-data-integrity:mdi-18.title: Alpaca after-hours close fallback stamps asOf as String(bar.time) and labels any history tier as 'yahoo-finance-delayed'

ux-copy-editor:copy-01.title: Two-space sentence rule is unenforced across ~600 web copy strings; SENTENCE_GAP used in only 9 files

ux-copy-editor:copy-02.title: Double ASCII spaces typed into JSX text collapse to one space at render — looks compliant in source, isn't on screen

ux-copy-editor:copy-03.title: Macro page says below-median buys are "hard-vetoed" in risk-off/crisis regimes; the code is advisory tag-not-drop

ux-copy-editor:copy-04.title: iOS tells the user to edit the universe "on the Strategy page" — the app has no Strategy screen and on the web the universe editor lives under Guardrails

ux-copy-editor:copy-05.title: "Approvals" vs "Proposals": nav/H1/iOS tab say Proposals, but a dozen copy strings send users to "Approvals"

ux-copy-editor:copy-06.title: Coach page still calls itself "the assistant" in six user-facing strings

ux-copy-editor:copy-07.title: One run state, three names (Exit-only / Close-only / Close Only) and one stop control, four names (Stop Agent / STOP everything / system stopped / strategy stopped) across web and iOS

ux-copy-editor:copy-08.title: Web console headings and buttons are sentence case ("Run once", "Commit changes", "Win rate") against the Title Case rule and against iOS ("Run Once", "Win Rate")

ux-copy-editor:copy-09.title: iOS mixes Title Case and sentence case inside the same tile rows, empty states, insight titles, and section subtitles; "Ask-First" vs "Ask-first"

ux-copy-editor:copy-10.title: "Green team"/"Red team" lowercase in 18 places vs "Green Team"/"Red Team" product names in 103

ux-copy-editor:copy-11.title: ALL-CAPS "(NOT Real Money)" / "(LIVE — Real Money)" account labels and shouting PAPER chips contradict `Alpaca (paper)` and the no-ceremony ruling

ux-copy-editor:copy-12.title: iOS proposal cards show a red "Live" pill on every live proposal — the rule and the iOS Home hero both say no Live callouts

ux-copy-editor:copy-13.title: Scolding + inaccurate breaker copy: "a hard limit did its job. Review what fired before loosening anything." while breakers are advisory by default

ux-copy-editor:copy-14.title: Setup copy says "Connect Alpaca or Robinhood" while Connections offers Alpaca, Robinhood, Tradier, Public and eToro

ux-copy-editor:copy-15.title: Web compact money renders uppercase suffixes ("$3.4T", "$850B", "$1K–$15K") via Intl compact; rule and iOS use lowercase k/m/b

ux-copy-editor:copy-16.title: "Mock (offline)" model is offered as the first group in the Coach model picker (web + iOS) and the server silently answers with a mock when no key resolves

ux-copy-editor:copy-17.title: Public pages, Terms and Privacy use sentence-case section headings and have zero NBSP/SENTENCE_GAP (all single-space sentences)

ux-copy-editor:copy-18.title: First-run/empty and loading copy leaks engineering vocabulary ("snapshot", "persisted decision trace", "dashboard API", "autonomy desk")

ux-copy-editor:copy-19.title: Same guardrail fields carry different labels on web vs iOS (Max per order / Max Order, Max spend per day / Daily Cap, Run every / Cadence, Base indices / Indices)

ux-copy-editor:copy-20.title: Settings jump-list labels do not match the card titles they scroll to (Display→Appearance, Boot→After a restart, AI budget→Daily AI Budget…)

ux-copy-editor:copy-21.title: "P/L" on Orders and proposal cards vs "P&L" everywhere else (web and iOS)

ux-copy-editor:copy-22.title: Microcopy nits: release-note voice ("Bulk approve now supports LIVE proposals"), brand spelled two ways, one browser-timezone timestamp

qa-test-strategy:qa-01.title: iOS unit tests never execute in CI or before TestFlight ship

qa-test-strategy:qa-02.title: Swift build result is not part of the required merge gate

qa-test-strategy:qa-03.title: Docs-only CI fast path skips the build for build-time-imported docs/benchmarks JSON

qa-test-strategy:qa-04.title: No API-to-iOS snapshot contract test; a server rename silently blanks phone lists

qa-test-strategy:qa-05.title: No global network guard in vitest; suite still reaches SEC/Yahoo/SiliconFlow

qa-test-strategy:qa-06.title: Browser coverage is one 18-line desktop smoke on `/`, not run on PRs, no phone width

qa-test-strategy:qa-07.title: Single-proposal approve, replace-market, pause/enable routes have no route-level tests (63/122 routes untested)

qa-test-strategy:qa-08.title: TestBrokerGateway always fills instantly, so integration tests can only see the happy path

qa-test-strategy:qa-09.title: MobileStore.submit/load are untested despite an existing URLProtocol harness

qa-test-strategy:qa-10.title: maxWorkers:1 serializes ~7,000 tests: `npm test` is ~14 min of every CI run

qa-test-strategy:qa-11.title: land.sh skips lint and never compiles Swift for ios/** diffs

qa-test-strategy:qa-12.title: ESLint warn backlog has no ratchet: 49 console warnings (26 set-state-in-effect), 346 in src/api/admin

qa-test-strategy:qa-13.title: No coverage tooling, so thin spots in policy/performance are invisible

qa-test-strategy:qa-14.title: Owner two-space sentence rule has no automated guard on the web (iOS has one)

qa-test-strategy:qa-15.title: Flat 614-file test dir with PR/agent-named files and two live-network scratch scripts

qa-test-strategy:qa-16.title: codex-autofix workflow fails on every review event, training everyone to ignore red checks

qa-test-strategy:qa-17.title: No invariant test that every API route resolves the request user or is explicitly public

qa-test-strategy:qa-18.title: Console and iOS run-state derivations are tested from separate hand-typed tables

ops-observability-admin:sre-01.title: No at-a-glance 'is the trader alive' panel on web/admin/iOS; run-state chip is intent, not liveness

ops-observability-admin:sre-02.title: schedulerStale, tradingLivenessDegraded and OpenRouter low-balance never trigger an in-app push; only external keyword monitors can page

ops-observability-admin:sre-03.title: Backup status can lie: litestream kill-switch markers are invisible to /api/health and Backup Status, and the R2 'writes paused' card ignores the B2 cutover

ops-observability-admin:sre-04.title: Docker HEALTHCHECK gives the heavy /api/health only 5s; documented 6–13s event-loop stalls can flip the container unhealthy and fail deploy swaps

ops-observability-admin:sre-05.title: /api/health cannot represent a broker outage when Alpaca runs on user-lane keys (the production case)

ops-observability-admin:sre-06.title: Admin and console have no route-level error boundaries; a render crash drops to the public-site-styled root boundary and loses the admin shell

ops-observability-admin:sre-07.title: Deploy drift is still only detectable by manually running verify-deploy-sha.sh

ops-observability-admin:sre-08.title: All app + litestream stdout is appended forever to a log file on the persistent data volume with no rotation

ops-observability-admin:sre-09.title: The LLM/OpenRouter chat lane has no Connections health lane; Admin Connections lists openai/anthropic/gemini/xai user lanes that never receive traffic under universal routing

ops-observability-admin:sre-10.title: Provider/storage alerts re-fire on fixed cooldowns with no 'recovered' event and no 'since/nth reminder', and storage alerting runs only as a side effect of GET /api/health

ops-observability-admin:sre-11.title: An overdue next run is never flagged: web says 'Next run now' forever, iOS says 'Next Run 12 minutes ago'

ops-observability-admin:sre-12.title: Broker-held protective stop declined/failed is audit-only; no owner push

ops-observability-admin:sre-13.title: Admin overview fabricates 'CPU load 0.0%' and '0 Running' when the series/probe is empty or failed

ops-observability-admin:sre-14.title: Three backup layers, zero restore drills — nothing ever proves the B2 replica or R2 cold snapshot restores

ops-observability-admin:sre-15.title: Sentry events carry no release; Langfuse release reads a Vercel var — neither uses the app's own release identity

ops-observability-admin:sre-16.title: Ops runbook docs are stale (PM2 litestream→R2, self-hosted gitleaks, 'restart pm2 trading') and there is no current 'what pages me and why' page

ops-observability-admin:sre-17.title: Server-knob writes are audited as user 'local' regardless of which admin flipped them

ops-observability-admin:sre-18.title: Copy nits on ops surfaces: 'Data catalog' nav label, iOS 'Next run' vs 'Next Run', unlabeled CT timestamps on overview

ops-observability-admin:sre-19.title: admin.socratictrade.com sub-route redirect list omits the newer admin pages

ops-observability-admin:sre-20.title: Overview R2 card tells the owner to run a curl (POST /api/admin/r2-usage/resume) instead of offering the action
